audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Lucian in both layers while whys[4] on the same page says 'it is only even here'.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror (audits/top/tahmkench__lucian.json) settles this chart as Lucian 1-3 on range, Skill at 4-5, Skill at 6, and both item stages to Tahm Kench. Restated from this side, only the Level 6 row was out of step. My packet chart also disagrees at row 3, but the mirror is the binding version and its reading matches this page's own prose.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] Lucian -> Skill, rating lowered. Rows 0-3, 5 and 6 already agreed with the mirror and were left alone.

audit.why: Four spikes present in the right order: Lvl 2 burst, Lvl 3 kite window, Lvl 6 The Culling versus Devour, 2+ items drain-tank. Only the slot letters inside them were wrong (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Devour his W in four places ('his W devour', 'devour (W)') and treats his R as a roaming tool ('roams (R)', 'roam (R) bot'). Devour is his R. His W is Abyssal Dive, the knockup dive.
audit.why: Riot text: W 'Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area'; R 'Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally'. The two buttons demand opposite responses and the full layer already tracks Abyssal Dive correctly, so the page contradicted itself.
audit.corrected: All slot letters fixed across whys, spikes, mid and wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states the three-stack gate on An Acquired Taste — the single mechanic that decides when you are actually in danger.
audit.why: Passive: 'Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.' Q: 'If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' So Tongue Lash is a slow at zero to two stacks and a stun at three, and Devour cannot touch you below three either. Counting your own stacks and disengaging at two removes both threats at once. The mirror recorded the same fact from his side ('bank three stacks and spend them on Devour').
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and the wants lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'grey health' sustain is attributed to his passive throughout. It is Thick Skin, his E.
audit.why: E text: 'Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.' On a 3s cooldown at 0 cost. That is why trickled poke does nothing and why one committed combo beats five pokes — and it is a shield you can bait out, which the flagged shield-absorbs-burst interaction is about.
audit.corrected: whys[3] and phases[3].why now name Thick Skin and say what it actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Confirmed — not one number on the page.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21/20/19/18/17s and is his only re-engage; Tongue Lash is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s at 900 range, which out-ranges everything Lucian has.
audit.corrected: Numbers and an explicit wait-for-X-then-Y line added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Piercing Light's piercing behaviour is never used.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.' Cast on a minion, it continues into Tahm behind it — so a wave between you is reach, not cover. The mirror flagged the same interaction from his side.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your kingdom. Your auto range plus Lightslinger means a Q into a double-shot chunks Tahm before he has the HP or grey-health pool to heal it off — so trade every time your passive is up. The one thing to respect is his tongue (Q): if it stuns you, he walks up and autos you in melee where your base HP is paper. Stay at the tip of your Q range, weave W for the move speed, and never sit still in a straight line for his stun.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your kingdom. Your auto range plus Lightslinger means a Q into a double-shot chunks Tahm before Thick Skin has a pool to heal it off — so trade every time your passive is up. Respect Tongue Lash (Q, 900 range, 7s at rank 1): it slows at one or two An Acquired Taste stacks and stuns at three, so count your stacks and break off at two. Stay at the tip of your Q, weave W for the speed, and never walk a straight line.

edits.before: You keep the edge through 4-5 but his grey-health passive starts eating your chip, so you need to commit, not just poke. At 6 The Culling is a real all-in, but be careful: his W can devour you mid-channel or eat your kill target, so only fire it when he is locked or low enough to execute outright.
edits.after: Trades hold through 4-5 but Thick Skin (E) banks your chip and hands it back as a shield, so commit rather than poke. Use Ardent Blaze (W) marks and the speed burst to dance in, double-tap, and E out before Tongue Lash's 7s is back. At 6 The Culling is a real all-in, but Devour (R) eats the channel once he has three stacks on you — only fire it when he is locked or low enough to execute.
